```{r libraries}
library(googledrive)
library(readxl)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)
library(progress)

```

```{r api_setup}
# ---- Set API key ----
OPENAI_API_KEY <- Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
stopifnot(nzchar(OPENAI_API_KEY))

# ---- Model settings ----
GPT_MODEL  <- "gpt-4o-mini"   # change to gpt-5-nano if preferred
MAX_TOKENS <- 2000
```

```{r load_data}
# ---- Authenticate with Google Drive ----
drive_auth()

file_id <- "1SAImqfbM5Frd0YzyXt_550ebbBKM9HVOGgYJRQG6v6w"
drive_download(as_id(file_id), path = "local_copy.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

adaptdata <- read_excel("local_copy.xlsx", sheet = "raw_data_BTRs")

cat("Total rows loaded:", nrow(adaptdata), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(adaptdata), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r classify}
# ---- GPT classification function ----
classify_urban_relevance <- function(text, api_key, model, max_tokens) {

  prompt <- paste0(
    "You are an expert in urban climate adaptation research.\n\n",
    "Your task is to classify the following text according to which urban concepts it references.\n\n",
    "For each of the following urban categories, state whether it is referenced (Yes/No) in the text.\n",
    "Consider all word variants and plurals for each category:\n\n",
    "1. Urban (keywords: urban, urbanisation, urbanization)\n",
    "2. City/Cities (keywords: city, cities)\n",
    "3. Municipality/Municipal (keywords: municipality, municipal, municipalities)\n",
    "4. Metropolitan/Metro (keywords: metropolitan, metro)\n",
    "5. Peri-urban (keywords: peri-urban, periurban)\n",
    "6. Informal settlement (keywords: informal settlement, informal settlements)\n",
    "7. Slum (keywords: slum, slums, slum-dwellers, slum-dwelling, slum-based)\n",
    "8. Township (keywords: township, townships)\n",
    "9. Town (keywords: town, towns)\n",
    "10. Built environment (keywords: built environment)\n",
    "11. Human settlement (keywords: human settlement, human settlements)\n\n",
    "Text:\n\"", text, "\"\n\n",
    "Respond ONLY with a JSON object in this exact format (no additional text):\n",
    "{\n",
    "  \"urban_relevant\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"urban\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"city_cities\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"municipality_municipal\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"metropolitan_metro\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"peri_urban\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"informal_settlement\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"slum\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"township\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"town\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"built_environment\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"human_settlement\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"reasoning\": \"one sentence explanation\"\n",
    "}"
  )

  response <- tryCatch({
    POST(
      url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
      add_headers(
        Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
        `Content-Type` = "application/json"
      ),
      body = toJSON(list(
        model                 = model,
        max_completion_tokens = max_tokens,
        messages              = list(
          list(role = "user", content = prompt)
        )
      ), auto_unbox = TRUE),
      encode = "json"
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("API call failed: ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })

  if (is.null(response)) {
    return(list(urban_relevant = "Error", urban = NA, city_cities = NA,
                municipality_municipal = NA, metropolitan_metro = NA,
                peri_urban = NA, informal_settlement = NA, slum = NA,
                township = NA, town = NA, built_environment = NA,
                human_settlement = NA, reasoning = "API call failed"))
  }

  cnt <- content(response, as = "parsed", encoding = "UTF-8")

  if (!is.null(cnt$error)) {
    return(list(urban_relevant = "Error", urban = NA, city_cities = NA,
                municipality_municipal = NA, metropolitan_metro = NA,
                peri_urban = NA, informal_settlement = NA, slum = NA,
                township = NA, town = NA, built_environment = NA,
                human_settlement = NA, reasoning = cnt$error$message))
  }

  raw_text <- cnt$choices[[1]]$message$content

  result <- tryCatch({
    clean_text <- gsub("```json|```", "", raw_text)
    clean_text <- str_trim(clean_text)
    fromJSON(clean_text)
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(urban_relevant = "Parse Error", urban = NA, city_cities = NA,
         municipality_municipal = NA, metropolitan_metro = NA,
         peri_urban = NA, informal_settlement = NA, slum = NA,
         township = NA, town = NA, built_environment = NA,
         human_settlement = NA, reasoning = raw_text)
  })

  return(result)
}

# ---- Run classification ----
total_rows  <- nrow(adaptdata)
error_count <- 0
results     <- vector("list", total_rows)

cat("Starting classification of", total_rows, "rows...\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(total_rows)) {

  text   <- adaptdata$ElementText[i]
  result <- classify_urban_relevance(
    text       = text,
    api_key    = OPENAI_API_KEY,
    model      = GPT_MODEL,
    max_tokens = MAX_TOKENS
  )

  if (!is.null(result$urban_relevant) &&
      result$urban_relevant %in% c("Error", "Parse Error")) {
    error_count <- error_count + 1
  }

  results[[i]] <- list(
    urban_relevant         = if (!is.null(result$urban_relevant))         result$urban_relevant         else NA,
    urban                  = if (!is.null(result$urban))                  result$urban                  else NA,
    city_cities            = if (!is.null(result$city_cities))            result$city_cities            else NA,
    municipality_municipal = if (!is.null(result$municipality_municipal)) result$municipality_municipal else NA,
    metropolitan_metro     = if (!is.null(result$metropolitan_metro))     result$metropolitan_metro     else NA,
    peri_urban             = if (!is.null(result$peri_urban))             result$peri_urban             else NA,
    informal_settlement    = if (!is.null(result$informal_settlement))    result$informal_settlement    else NA,
    slum                   = if (!is.null(result$slum))                   result$slum                   else NA,
    township               = if (!is.null(result$township))               result$township               else NA,
    town                   = if (!is.null(result$town))                   result$town                   else NA,
    built_environment      = if (!is.null(result$built_environment))      result$built_environment      else NA,
    human_settlement       = if (!is.null(result$human_settlement))       result$human_settlement       else NA,
    reasoning              = if (!is.null(result$reasoning))              result$reasoning              else NA
  )

  # Progress update every 10 rows
  if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == 1) {
    cat(sprintf("  Row %d / %d (%.0f%%) | Errors: %d\n",
                i, total_rows, (i / total_rows) * 100, error_count))
    flush.console()
  }

  Sys.sleep(0.2)
}

# ---- Bind results ----
results_df            <- bind_rows(lapply(results, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
adaptdata_classified <- bind_cols(adaptdata, results_df) %>%
  mutate(needs_review = urban_relevant %in% c("Error", "Parse Error"))

cat("\n\nClassification complete!\n")
cat("Urban Relevant - Yes:", sum(adaptdata_classified$urban_relevant == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Urban Relevant - No: ", sum(adaptdata_classified$urban_relevant == "No",  na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Errors:              ", sum(adaptdata_classified$needs_review,             na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r export}
# ---- Export to Excel ----
output_path <- "urban_relevance_classified.xlsx"
write_xlsx(adaptdata_classified, path = output_path)
cat("Results saved to:", output_path, "\n")
```

```{r summary_table}
# ---- Summary of urban category hits ----
summary<- adaptdata_classified %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Rows             = n(),
    Urban_Relevant         = sum(urban_relevant         == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Urban                  = sum(urban                  == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    City_Cities            = sum(city_cities            == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Municipality_Municipal = sum(municipality_municipal == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Metropolitan_Metro     = sum(metropolitan_metro     == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Peri_Urban             = sum(peri_urban             == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Informal_Settlement    = sum(informal_settlement    == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Slum                   = sum(slum                   == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Township               = sum(township               == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Town                   = sum(town                   == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Built_Environment      = sum(built_environment      == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Human_Settlement       = sum(human_settlement       == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
